properties.directions: From Blue River, OR, travel east on Highway 126 for 4 miles to Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Turn right (south) on Forest Road 19, continuing straight past the Y onto Forest Road 410. Continue south on Forest Road 410 to the bottom of Cougar Reservoir and turn left (east) onto Forest Road 411. Continue up Forest Road 411 for 4 miles to Echo Trailhead at a roadside parking area on the right side of the road.
From Sisters, OR: 1.5 miles west on Highway 242 (McKenzie Pass Highway), then approximately 10 miles south on Forest Service Road 15.

From Oakridge, OR, at the traffic signal, proceed over the overpass (Crestview) and turn right at the next intersection (East 1st Street). Travel through Oakridge to Forest Road 24 (Salmon Creek Road) and continue for 10 miles to Forest Road 2417. Follow Forest Road 2417 for 11 miles to Forest Road 2417-254. Proceed on Forest Road 254 for 0.25 mile to the Winchester Lake Trailhead, which is located on the right side of the road. The Winchester Ridge Trail #3596 is reached by hiking the Winchester Trail #3594 for approximately 1.4 miles.

From Oakridge, OR, travel east on Highway 58 for 2 miles to Kitson Springs County Road. Turn right and proceed on Kitson Springs County Road (which becomes Forest Road 23) for about 20 miles to the Vivian Lake Trailhead located on the left side of Forest Road 23. ;

Take Forest Road 40 about 26 miles west of Sunriver, continue on Forest Road 4630 to Little Cultus Lake. Take Forest Road 4736 a short distance to the Lemish Lake Trailhead.  Alternate access is from Forest Road 4290 near Charlton Lake.

From Lowell, OR, travel 2 miles north on the Jasper-Lowell Road, turn right at the Unity Bridge on to the Big Fall Creek Road. Turn right at Winberry Creek Road (Forest Road 1802), and proceed 9 miles. At the junction of Forest Roads 1802, 150 and 160, turn right onto Forest Road 150 and travel 5 miles. Just before crossing the Cabin Creek Bridge, there is a short spur road on the left. Proceed up this spur road for a short distance to its end. There is adequate parking and turn around room.

From Glide, OR following OR 138 E, turn left onto Forest Service Road (FSR) 2610/Birds Point Road, just past dam turn left to stay on FSR 2610/NF 600,  at he intersection turn left onto FSR 2610-680/Lemolo Plant Road.  Trailhead is ahead on the west side of the road.

From Oakridge, OR, travel east on Highway 58, turn left at the traffic light, proceed over the overpass and turn right at the next intersection. Travel through Oakridge, OR, to Forest Road 24 (Salmon Creek Road) and continue for 10 miles to Forest Road 2417. Follow Forest Road 2417 for approximately 12.5 miles to the end of the road. The end of the road is the trailhead.

From Oakridge, OR, travel east on Highway 58 to the traffic signal. Turn left at the traffic signal, proceed over the overpass and turn right at the next intersection. Travel through Oakridge to Forest Road 24 (Salmon Creek Road) and continue for approximately 13.5 miles to Forest Road 2422. Turn left and follow Forest Road 2422 for 12 miles to the end of the road where the trailhead is located.

From McKenzie Bridge, OR, travel west on Highway 126 to Forest Road 2638 (Horse Creek Road). Travel southeast on Forest Road 2638 to Forest Road 356. Turn right and head southwest up Forest Road 356 to Forest Road 1993. Turn right, traveling along the side of Horsepasture Mountain traveling northwest on Forest Road 1993 to a small pullout on the uphill side at Horsepasture Trailhead.

properties.water_availability: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
properties.directions: From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 19 miles to Forest Road 2470. Turn right on County Road 2470 and continue for 4 miles along Brice Creek to Cedar Creek Trailhead, located on the left side of the road.
From McKenzie Bridge, OR, travel east on Highway 126 to Highway 242. Travel east on Highway 242 for 9 miles to Proxy Falls Trailhead.

properties.public_site_name: McKenzie River Trailhead at Paradise CG
properties.directions: From McKenzie Bridge, OR, follow Highway 126 east 5 miles and turn left (north) into Paradise Campground (Forest Road 300). Past the 2 gates on your left, there will be parking on the right before the one way loop in the road. This parking is for McKenzie River Trailhead at Paradise Campground.

properties.directions: From Bend, OR: Travel 24.0 miles west on Cascade Lakes Highway (46), then 3.2 miles north on Forest Road 4600-370 to junction with Road 4600-378, then go west to the; end of the road.

properties.water_availability: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
properties.directions: From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 19 miles to Brice Creek Road 2470. Turn right on County Road 2470 and continue for 8 miles. East Brice Creek Trailhead is located on the left side of the road.

The trailhead has changed for this trail in the last few years from Hwy 58 to Forest Road 5850 just a short distance up this road to the trailhead on the right.How To Get There: From Eugene, Oregon, travel about 7.3 miles to Highway 58. Travel east on Highway 58 for approximately 31.5 miles, turn right on to Forest Road 5850, travel just a few hundred yards to the parking area on the right. (Note the trail is shared with a fitness trail for a few hundred feet) Follow sign to new portion of trail.The upper end of the trail is reached by traveling back to the west on Highway 58 for 1.9 miles to Forest Road 5847. Forest Road 5847 is 2.4 miles west of the Middle Fork Ranger District office. Follow this road for 4.4 miles to Forest Road 549. Turn left and proceed 3.4 miles. The trailhead is located on the left side of the road.
From Bend: Roughly 50 miles SW of Bend; the Many Lakes Trailhead is located on Forest Service Road 4636, about 3.5 miles west of Little Cultus Lake.

properties.water_availability: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
properties.directions: From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, turn left across the dam onto Forest Road 1993 and drive 3 miles to East Fork, Lower Trailhead at the end of a parking lot on the northeast corner of the 1993 and 1994 Forest Road junctions.

From Crescent, OR- Travel 12.2 miles west on County Road 61, then go 3.5 miles north on Hwy 58 to Crescent Lake Junction. From the junction go towards Crescent Lake and take Forest Road 60 west for 5 miles. Turn right on Forest Service Road #6010 going to Summit Lake. Approximately 5 miles up Forest Road #6010, Snell Lake Trail #43 crosses the road.

From Lowell, OR, Covered Bridge (Oregon State Highway 58 Milepost 13.5) travel 0.6 miles north on the Jasper-Lowell Road, turn left on North Shore Drive and travel 0.1 mile to Moss Street. Turn right on Moss (Jasper / Lowell Road), travel 1.9 mile to the Big Fall Creek Road (just before the Unity Covered Bridge). Turn right on Big Fall Creek Road and proceed 1 mile and turn right at the Winberry Road (Forest Road 1802). Travel 9 miles to the junction of Forest Roads 1802, 150 and 160. Continue on Forest Road 1802 for a very short distance and turn right on the Forest Road 814 and park at the end of the road. Walk downstream to Forest Road 150 and cross the stream on the road bridge. The Station Butte Trail #3471 begins on the left side of the road.

From Crescent: Travel 1 miles west on County Road 61 then take a right (north) onto Hwy 58 for approximately 10.5 miles; take a left (south) onto Forest Service Road 5810 and travel approximately 2 miles to trailhead.

From Lowell, Oregon, travel 2 miles north on the Jasper-Lowell Road and turn right at the Unity Bridge, and proceed 16.8 miles on Big Fall Creek Road (Forest Road 18) to Forest Road 1825. Turn right, proceed 2.3 miles to Forest Road 1835, turn left and go 0.6 mile to Forest Road 1835-220, and park on the left.

properties.site_name: CLARK CREEK NATURE TRAIL (LOW CLK BUTTE)
properties.recarea_name: CLARK CREEK NATURE TRAIL (LOW CLK BUTTE)
properties.directions: Travel 2 miles north from Lowell, Oregon on Jasper-Lowell Road, turn right at the Unity Bridge and proceed 12.8 miles on the Big Fall Creek Road (Forest Road 18). There is a very good parking and turn around area on the left side of the road just past the entrance to the Clark Creek Organization Camp.
From Bend, travel 46 miles southwest on Cascade Lakes Hwy (46), then west on Forest Road 4635 for 2 miles. Trail begins from Winopee Lake Trailhead near Cultus Lake Campground.

From Lowell, OR, travel 2 miles north on the Jasper-Lowell Road, turn right at the Unity Bridge and proceed 16.2 miles on Big Fall Creek Road (Forest Road 18).Turn right on to Forest Road 1824 and travel 7.7 miles. Keep left at Forest Road 142 and proceed 1.1 miles to Forest Road 144. Turn right and travel 0.8 mile to the end of the road. The trail begins on the left side of the road.The other end of the trail is reached by traveling on Forest Road 1824-142 for 2.9 miles to Forest Road 143 and going 0.9 mile to the trailhead. Forest Road 143 is closed to motor vehicle traffic in the spring for wildlife management.

From Eugene, OR, follow Highway 58 for 70 miles to Willamette Pass. Just east of the pass turn right at Odell Lake Road. Follow this paved road for 1.8 miles to the Yoran Lake trailhead. From Crescent, OR,  travel 12.2 miles west on County Road 61, then about 10 miles north on Highway 58 to just east of Willamette Pass and turn left on Odell Lake Road. Follow this paved road for 1.8 miles to the Yoran Lake trailhead.
From Bend, OR: Travel west on Cascade Lakes Highway (Highway 46) for 26 miles, then travel south on Forest Road 400 for 1 mile to the Ray Atkeson Trailhead/Sparks Lake Boat ramp.

ACCESS #1 (via Brice Creek): From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 19 miles to where it junctions with Brice Creek Road and Layng Creek Road. Keep right, following Brice Creek Road 2470 for 12 miles. (Note: Brice Creek Road number changes from County Road 2470 to Forest Road 22 at Champion Creek Road). Stay on Brice Creek Road for 12 miles and turn right onto Noonday Road 2212 (follow the signs to Fairview Peak) and travel for 6.7 miles to the junction of Forest Roads 2212 and 2212-767. Keep to the right of Forest Road 2212 for another 2.1 miles to the junction of Sharps Creek Road 2460. Continue left for 1.1 miles to the junction of Fairview Peak Road 2460-773.
ACCESS #2 (via Sharps Creek): From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 15.3 miles to Sharps Creek Road 2460. Stay to the left and continue on Forest Road 2460 for 7.3 miles to the junction of Fairview Peak Road 2460-773. The last 5.5 miles of this route is rough, narrow and steep. This route is not recommended for low-clearance passenger cars. Use low gear and drive slowly and with caution.
The trailhead is 40 miles southeast of Cottage Grove, OR.

FROM HIGHWAY 58: From the Middle Fork Ranger Station on Hwy 58, travel east towards Oakridge, OR for 5 miles. Turn left on to Fish Hatchery Road. At the stop sign, turn right onto Forest Road 24 (Salmon Creek Road). Continue 9 miles to Forest Road 1934 (Blair Lake). Turn left onto Forest Road 1934 and continue for 0.5 mile. It is approximately 0.5 miles from the trailhead to the hot springs.

From McKenzie Bridge, OR, travel west on Highway 126 to Forest Road 2638 (Horse Creek Road). Travel south on Forest Road 2638 about 3 miles to Forest Road 1993. Travel southwest up Forest Road 1993 about 3 miles to a small parking area on the north side of the road. Ollalie North Trailhead is directly south across Forest Road 1993 from this parking area.

From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, continue south on Forest Road 19 for 25.5 miles and turn left (east) onto Forest Road 1958. Continue east up this road to Crossing Way Trailhead on the right (west) side of the road.
From Bend, OR travel 35 miles west on Highway 46 (Cascade Lakes Highway) to the Six Lakes trailhead.

From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, turn left across the dam onto Forest Road 1993 and continue up the road to a spur road on the right (south) side of the road. Follow that spur south around the loop to Pat Saddle Trailhead.

properties.directions: From Bend, OR: Travel 41.1 miles southwest on Cascade Lakes Highway (46), then 0.1 miles west on Forest Road 4628, then 1.8 miles west on Forest Road 4632.
From Oakridge, OR, go east on Highway 58 for 23 miles to the Waldo Lake Road 5897. Follow Waldo Lake Road for 5.5 miles to trailhead on left.

From Oakridge, OR, travel east on Highway 58, for 23 miles to Forest Road 5897 (Waldo Lake Road). Turn left and follow Forest Road 5897 for 11 miles to Forest Road 5898, which leads to North Waldo Campground and Islet Campground. Continue left (main paved road) on Forest Road 5898 and drive toward North Waldo Campground and turn right onto Forest Road 5989-514 (Taylor Burn Road). Follow Forest Road 514 for 6 miles to the trailhead, which is located on the right side of the road.

properties.water_availability: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
properties.directions: From Glide, OR, follow OR-138 E, turn left onto Forest Service Road (FSR) 60, turn right to stay on FSR 60, destination will be on the right.
From McKenzie Bridge, OR, travel west on Highway 126 to Forest Road 2638 (Horse Creek Road). Travel southeast on Forest Road 2638 to a small pull out on the left (east) at Horse Creek Trailhead.

From Crescent: Head west on Crescent Cutoff (County Road 61), turn right onto Highway 58 for approximately 4 miles, turn left onto Forest Service Road 60 and travel approximately 5 miles to the trailhead.
From Crescent: Travel 1 miles west on County Road 61 then take a right (north) onto Hwy 58 for approximately 10.5 miles and take a right at the ODOT sandshed; trailhead will be on your right.

From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, continue south on Forest Road 19 for 26 miles and turn right (west) into Box Canyon Horse Camp and Box Canyon Trailhead by the water troughs.

properties.directions: From Oakridge, Oregon: At the intersection of Crestview Street and Oregon State Highway 58 (at the only traffic light along State Highway 58 in Oakridge), travel east on Highway 58 for 23.3 miles. Turn left onto the Waldo Lake Road/Forest Road 5897. Travel for approximately 12 miles. ; Where the paved road begins a sharp left curve, stay straight and follow the road (which becomes unpaved) into the camp.

To reach the White Mule Trailhead, turn north off Hwy 138 at milepost 72 onto Forest Road 2610 (Birds Point Road) and travel 5.2 miles across dam which forms Lemolo Reservoir. Stay left onto Forest Road 2610 about 0.75 mile. Trailhead is on the left. Parking available for three standard vehicles, very tight for horse trailers.

From McKenzie Bridge, OR, drive east on Highway 126 for 3 miles to Forest Road 2643 (Foley Ridge Road). Follow Forest Road 2643 uphill for 10 miles to Forest Road 480. Turn right (west) on Forest Road 480 and follow it to a loop where it ends at Separation Lake Trailhead.
From Bend, OR: Travel 28.7 miles west on Cascade Lakes Highway (46). The trailhead is adjacent to Devils Lake.

From McKenzie Bridge, OR, travel east on Highway 126 to Highway 242. Travel east on Highway 242 for 16 miles to Hand Lake Trailhead. The Trailhead is on the left (northwest) side of the highway, parking is on the right (southeast) side.
The site is located at milepost 21 of OR Highway 58 when travelling eastbound.

From Oakridge, Oregon, travel east on Highway 58 for 2 miles to Kitson Springs County Road. ; Turn right and proceed on Kitson Springs County Road for 0.5 miles to Forest Road 21. ; Turn right and continue for 3 miles to the trailhead at Larison Cove. ; Turn right into the lower trailhead parking lot.To reach the upper trailhead,; travel 1 mile on Forest Road 21 to Forest Road 2102, turn right and follow Forest Road 2102 for approximately 2 miles to Forest Road 2102-101.Turn left onto Forest Road 101 and travel about 8 miles to the trailhead. ; The last mile of Forest Road 101 to the trailhead is steep. ; The trailhead is on the left side of the road.

properties.directions: From Bend, travel 26.7 miles west on Cascade Lakes Hwy (46).

properties.directions: From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 19 miles, continue on Brice Creek Road for 3.5 miles until reaching West Brice Creek Trailhead, locate on the right side of the road.

From Crescent, OR- Travel 12.2 miles west on County Road 61, then go 3.5 miles north on Hwy 58 to Crescent Lake Junction. From the junction go towards Crescent Lake and take Forest Road 60 west for 5 miles. Turn right on Forest Service Road #6010 going to Summit Lake. Approximately 5 miles up Forest Road #6010, Snell Lake Trail #43 crosses the road.
From McKenzie Bridge, OR, drive east on Highway 126 for 3 miles to Forest Road 2643 (Foley Ridge Road). Follow Forest Road 2643 to its terminus at Foley Ridge Trailhead.

Travel east on Highway 58 from the City of Oakridge for 2 miles to Kitson Springs County Road. Turn right and proceed on Kitson Springs County Road for 0.5 miles to Forest Road 21. Turn right and continue for 3 miles to the trailhead at Larison Cove. Turn right into the trailhead parking lot.The upper trailhead can be reached by traveling 1 mile on Forest Road 21 to Forest Road 2102; turn left and follow Forest Road 2102 for approximately 2 miles to Forest Road 2102-101. Turn left onto Forest Road 101 and travel about 8 miles to the trailhead. The last mile of Forest Road 101 to the trailhead is steep. The trailhead is on the left side of the road.

From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, continue south on Forest Road 19 for 20 miles and turn left (north) onto Forest Road 441. Continue down this road to Olallie South Trailhead at the end of the road.
From Bend, OR: Travel 38.8 miles west on Cascade Lakes Highway (46) on the west side of the highway.

properties.directions: From Bend, OR: Travel approximately 29 miles west on Cascade Lakes Hwy (46). Turn south (left) at the sign for Devil 's Lake trailhead.

From Oakridge, OR, travel east on Highway 58, for 23 miles to Forest Road 5897 (Waldo Lake Road). Turn left and follow Forest Road 5897 for 4 miles to the trailhead, which is located on the left side of the road.Map Location:T.22 S., R.6 E., W.M., Sections 20, 19, 18 & 13

properties.directions: From McKenzie Bridge, OR, travel east on Highway 125 for 1.5 miles to Lower McKenzie River Trailhead, accessed at a long pullout on the north side of the Highway.

properties.directions: From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, continue south on Forest Road 19 for 7 miles to French Pete Trailhead.
From Bend, OR: Travel 30 miles southwest on Cascade Lakes Highway (46) and the trailhead is on the west side of the road.

From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, turn left across the dam onto Forest Road 1993 and continue up the road to a small parking area on the right (south) side of the road at East Fork, Upper Trailhead.

From Crescent, OR travel about 12 miles west on County Road 61, then 3.5 miles north on Highway 58, then 7 miles west on Forest Road 60, continue west on Forest Road 6010 for 6.5 miles to Summit Lake and Emigrant Pass trailhead.

properties.restrictions: If entering the Three Sisters Wilderness: Wilderness restrictions applyView maps of areas where camping/campfire/dog restrictions apply:; Dog leash restrictions,; Camp Chambers,; Green Lakes,; Matthieu Lakes,; Golden Lake,; Moraine Lakes,; Sisters Mirror.
properties.directions: From Bend, OR: Travel 46.0 miles southwest on Cascade Lakes Highway (46), then 0.8 miles west on Forest Road 4635, then 1.7 miles southwest on Forest Road 4630, then 0.7 miles southwest on Forest Road 4636, and then less than a mile northwest on Forest Road 4636-640.
From Oakridge, OR, go east on Highway 58 for 23 miles to the Waldo Lake Road 5897. Follow Waldo Lake Road for 5.5 miles to trailhead on the right.

From Bend, follow the Cascade Lakes Highway west for 46 miles. Turn right on Forest Service Road 4635, when you see a sign for Cultus Lake. In less than 1 mile, turn left on Forest Service Road 4630, where you see a sign that says Little Cultus Lake, 3 miles, and Irish and Taylor lakes, 7 miles.

From Blue River, OR, travel 4 miles east on Highway 126 and turn right onto Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Continue right at the Y junction for 3 miles to the top of Cougar Reservoir. At the reservoir, continue south on Forest Road 19 for 10 miles to Rebel Trailhead.

Cat Mountain Trailhead is approximately 25 miles southeast of Cottage Grove, OR. From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 19 miles to the junction of Layng Creek Road 17 and Brice Creek Road 2470, continue right on Brice Creek Road 2470 for 6.2 miles to Cat Creek Road 2263. Turn right and continue on Cat Creek Road 2263 for 6.2 miles to Forest Road 2263-763 on the right. Follow Forest Road 2263-763 for 3.9 miles to the trailhead on the right.

properties.directions: From Bend, OR travel 33.0 miles west on Cascade Lakes Hwy (46).

From McKenzie Bridge, OR, drive east on Highway 126 for 3 miles to Forest Road 2643 (Foley Ridge Road). Follow Forest Road 2643 uphill for 8 miles to Rainbow Falls Trailhead at a pullout on the right (south) side of the road.

Travel 2 miles north from Lowell, Oregon, on the Jasper-Lowell Road and turn right at the Unity Bridge, and proceed 16.8 miles on Big Fall Creek Road (Forest Road 18) to Forest Road 1825. Turn right, proceed 2.3 miles to Forest Road 1835, turn left and go 0.6 mile to Forest Road 1835-220, and turn left again. Continue approximately 0.5 miles. Trailhead parking for the lower trailhead is on the left side of the road.The upper trailhead is reached by continuing on the Fall Creek Road past Forest Road 1825 for 6.6 miles. Turn right on Forest Road 1835, proceed 6.1 miles to the junction with Forest Road 1835-365. Turn right and the trailhead is a short distance up this road.

From McKenzie Bridge, OR, drive east on Highway 126 about 2 miles to the junction of Highway 242. Travel northeast 17 miles on Highway 242 to Forest Road 250. Turn right (east) onto Forest Road 250, and turn right at the next Y junction. At the next Y junction, turn right and follow the loop to the far end to find Obsidian Hiker Trailhead.

properties.directions: From Crescent, OR: Travel 12.2 miles west on County Road 61/Crescent Cut-off Road, then 5.4 miles north on Highway 58, then turn left onto east Odell Lake Road/Forest Service Road 680 for approximately .10 of a mile, then follow the signs.
From Westfir, OR, continue up Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide Drive) for 30 miles to the trailhead, which is located on the right side of the road.Approximately 3 miles past Constitution Grove Trailhead.

From Eugene, Oregon, travel about 7.3 miles to Highway 58. Go east on Highway 58 to the crossing of Deception Creek (Highway 58 Milepost 31.0). Deception Creek is approximately 0.5 mile west of the Middle Fork Ranger District office.Take Forest Road 5850 located just west of the Middle Fork Ranger District compound. There is a small parking lot a short distance from Highway 58. There is a short loop trail, and the Deception Butte lower trailhead is on the loop.To reach the upper end of the trail, travel back to the west on Highway 58 for 1.9 miles to Forest Road 5847. ( Forest Road 5847 is 2.4 miles west of the Middle Fork Ranger District office.)Follow this road for 4.4 miles to Forest Road 549. Turn left and proceed 3.4 miles. The trailhead is located on the left side of the road.
From Sisters, OR: 5.8 miles west on Hwy. 242, then 6.4 miles south on Forest. Road 1018, then 1.3 miles west on Forest Road 1026 and travel about a mile to the Scott Pass trailhead.

From Oakridge, OR, travel east on Highway 58, for 23 miles to Forest Road 5897 (Waldo Lake Road). Turn left and follow Forest Road 5897 for 11 miles to Forest Road 5898, which leads to North Waldo Campground and Islet Campground. Continue left (main paved road) on Forest Road 5898 and drive toward North Waldo Campground and turn right onto Forest Road 5898-514 (Taylor Burn Road). Follow Forest Road 514 for 7 miles to the trailhead, which is located on the left side of the road.Map Location:T.20 S., R.6 E., W.M., Sections 28 & 33

properties.water_availability: Water can be treated or filtered from nearby water sources
properties.directions: From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 19 miles to Brice Creek Road 2470. Turn right on County Road 2470 and continue for 7 miles to Lund Park Trailhead, which is located on the left side of the road.
From Crescent, travel 12.2 miles west on County Road 61, then 3.5 miles north on Hwy 58, then about 2 miles west on Forest Road 60 to Fawn Lake trailhead.

From McKenzie Bridge, OR, proceed east on Highway 126 for 8 miles to Forest Road 2649 (Scott Road). Turn right (east), heading up Forest Road 2649 to Forest Road 640. Turn left (north) onto Forest Road 640 and follow it to Tenas Lakes Trailhead. Trailhead is on the right (east) and parking is on the left (west).

From Cottage Grove, OR, travel east on Row River Road 2400 for 19 miles to the junction of Layng Creek Road 17, and Brice Creek Road 2470. Bear right on Brice Creek Road 2470 and continue for 6.2 miles to Cat Creek Road 2263. Turn right and continue on Cat Creek Road 2263 for 1.7 miles to Dog Creek Road 717. Bear right on Dog Creek Road 717 and travel 3.1 miles to Forest Road 2263-834. Bear right on Forest Road 2263-834. While on Forest Road 2263-834, stay to your left and travel 1.25 miles to the end of the road. The trailhead is on the right.
The trailhead is approximately 35 miles southeast of Cottage Grove.

From Blue River, OR, travel east on Highway 126 for 4 miles to Forest Road 19 (Aufderheide). Turn left (south) on Forest Road 19, continuing straight past the Y onto Forest Road 410. Continue south on Forest Road 410 to the bottom of Cougar Reservoir and turn left (east) onto Forest Road 411. Continue up Forest Road 411 for 3 miles to a roadside parking area on the right side of the road. O'Leary / Castle Rock Trailhead is across the road from the parking area.

From Oakridge, OR, travel 4 miles west, turn right onto Westfir Road (Highway 58 Milepost 31.5). Turn left after crossing the green bridge over the Middle Fork Willamette River and proceed for approximately 1 mile.Turn left at the community of Hemlock, OR (Winfrey Road), turn left after crossing the bridge and proceed 4.5 miles to Forest Road 5826.Proceed 4 miles to the trailhead, which is located on the left side of the road. Parking space is limited. The upper trailhead is reached by traveling on the North Shore Road to Forest Road 5824, traveling 4.5 miles to the junction of Forest Roads 5824 and 5824-124. Turn on to Forest Road 5824-124 and travel 2 miles to the trailhead.

properties.water_availability: No; drinking water is available at nearby campgrounds
properties.directions: From Oakridge, follow Highway 58 east for 28 miles to Gold Lake Road (Forest Service Road 500). Follow Gold Lake Road for 2 miles to Gold Lake Campground.

properties.restrictions: There is no camping at the boat ramp or day use area.
properties.directions: From Bend, OR: Travel 26.2 miles west on Cascade Lakes Highway (46), then 0.2 miles south on Forest Road 4600 400.
